name: AA-LCR
intro: AA-LCR 是一个由 100 道人工题目组成的长上下文基准，覆盖 30 个真实世界多文档集、234 篇文档和 2,979,757 tokens，完整提示平均 99,325 tokens。题目要求跨文档进行通用或数学推理，不能靠直接检索作答；每道保留题都经过非前沿模型难度检查和至少一名人工验证者解答。
build_method: 真实多文档集整理、人工出题、非前沿模型难度检查、人工答案验证
metric: 准确率（Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 等价性判定）
eval_feature: 长上下文推理, 多文档推理, 多步推理
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Knowledge QA, Math Reasoning
build_method_en: Real multi-document curation, human question writing, non-frontier-model difficulty checks, human answer validation
eval_feature_en: Long-context reasoning, multi-document reasoning, multi-step reasoning
intro_en: AA-LCR is a 100-question long-context benchmark built over 30 real-world multi-document sets, 234 documents, and 2,979,757 tokens, with completed prompts averaging 99,325 tokens. Its general and mathematical questions require cross-document reasoning rather than direct retrieval; every retained item passes non-frontier-model difficulty checks and is solved by at least one human validator.
drawio_review_note: PASS reviewed against the official Artificial Analysis AA-LCR Hugging Face Data card pinned at bdae010bbce259820c0e34c1d7cce210d966fb75; no standalone paper is available. The unchanged topology preserves 30 document sets, 234 documents, 2,979,757 total tokens, the 99,325-token average completed prompt, seven document types, human authoring, three non-frontier difficulty checks, revise/discard validation with at least one human solver, the 100-question release, prompting that loads and concatenates documents in the explicit data_source_filenames list order rather than lexicographic filename order, Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 non-reasoning equality judging, binary verdicts, and accuracy.
